question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"projected."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Projected"** means estimated or predicted, to guess or calculate the size, cost or amount of something. (किसी वस्‍तु के आकार, लागत या मात्रा का अनुमान या हिसाब लगाना) • **Example**: *There was a **projected**__ increase of 110%.* • The sentence implies that something was estimated or predicted. • The correct answer is Option 1.​ • Correct passage: The world is becoming increasingly (1) __**urbanised**__ Since 2007, more than half of the world's population has been living in cities, and that share is (2) **__projected__** to rise to 60 percent by 2030. Cities and metropolitan areas are powerhouses of economic growth-______ (3) ______ about 60 percent of global GDP. However, they also account for about 70 percent of global carbon emissions and over 60 percent of ______ (4) ______ use. Rapid urbanisation is resulting in a growing number of slum dwellers, inadequate and (5)________ infrastructure and services, worsening air pollution, and unplanned urban sprawl. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "contrived"**, means deliberately created or arranged in a way that seems artificial or unrealistic. (कठिनाइयों के बावजूद कुछ करने में सफल होना) • **Option 3, "multiplied"**, means increased in number or quantity. (किसी अंक को निर्दिष्ट संख्‍या से गुणा करना) • **Option 4, "planned"**, means carefully thought out and organized in advance. (भविष्‍य के कामों के विषय में निर्णय करना, उन्‍हें व्‍यवस्थित या उनकी तैयारी करना; योजना बनाना) 3f:Tec1, The correct answer is **"contributing."**
